whenToUse: Showing one-time recovery codes after two-factor enrolment or in security settings.
Letting users copy, download or regenerate codes, with spent codes kept visible.
avoidWhen: Entering a single code — use input-otp.
Showing a scannable secret — use qr-code.
a11y: The code grid is a labelled group, used codes are announced via sr-only text, and copy feedback uses role="status" with aria-live.
